summary.text: Female-shaped trees are peculiar trees whose trunks and branches form like a girl's body, raised as a special aperture resource.

claims.text: Xiao Hun blessed land stays covered in dense dark clouds, and female-shaped trees grow on the ground. The trees are peculiar: the trunk is curved and branches wrap around each other like a girl’s naked body, in all kinds of enchanting postures, forming a forest. In the deepest part stands the tallest female-shaped tree, one thousand feet high, with roots extending for a range of ten thousand li. That female-shaped tree king does not look seductive; it gives off a pure and holy aura, with a ramrod-straight trunk, two enormous branches as hands covering the chest, and side branches forming palms that lift a green treehouse covered in red vermillion fruits.

In the central area of Xiao Hun blessed land is a large dense forest of trees in postures resembling female bodies. This is a special resource Hei Cheng raised in his immortal aperture. The kind of tree is not found in nature; Hei Cheng can be considered its creator, so these female-shaped trees are one of a kind.

Origin.text: Hei Cheng's creation in Xiao Hun blessed land
